info.text:
# Gravity Circuit

## What does randomization do to this game?
Every Circuit boss, rescue bot, health/burst booster and palette chip is a check. Stages are locked on the
stage select until you receive their Access item. Boss Burst Techniques and booster chips are items instead of
shop unlocks.

## What is the goal?
Open the Fortress by defeating the required number of Circuit bosses, then beat the final boss in Fortress 3. With
the Fortress Access Items option, Fortress 1 and 2 are opened by items instead, and only Fortress 3 needs the bosses.

## Which items can be in another player's world?
Stage Access items, the 16 boss Burst Techniques, booster chips 2–20 (Air Jumper included), Health and Burst
Upgrades, armor paints and credit bundles.

## What does another world's item look like in Gravity Circuit?
The pickup behaves normally on screen, and the overlay in the bottom-left says what was sent and to whom.

## When the player receives an item, what happens?
It is applied right away and announced in the overlay. Stage Access shows up when you open the stage select.

tutorials.text:
# Gravity Circuit Archipelago Setup

## Requirements
- Gravity Circuit on Steam, v1.2.2 (Windows, or Linux / Steam Deck through Proton)
- The Gravity Circuit Archipelago mod download (`install.ps1`, `install.sh`, `mod\`)

## Installing
1. Run `install.ps1`. It copies the mod into `%APPDATA%\Gravity Circuit\`, the game's save folder.
   On Linux / Steam Deck, start the game once, then run `sh install.sh`; it installs into the game's Proton prefix.
2. Launch the game normally from Steam.

## Connecting
1. Press **F9** in game.
2. Enter the server address (for example `archipelago.gg:38281`), your slot name and the password, then press Enter.
3. Start a **new game in an empty save slot**. That save is linked to your slot from then on.

The connection details are remembered. Next time the game reconnects on its own.

## Troubleshooting
See `%APPDATA%\Gravity Circuit\archipelago\ap_log.txt`.

readme.text:
# Gravity Circuit Archipelago

An [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg) multiworld randomizer for **Gravity Circuit** (Steam, v1.2.2).

The game connects to the Archipelago server by itself. There is no external client and the game executable is never
modified: the client is loaded from the game's save folder.

- **Archipelago game name:** `Gravity Circuit (MuratDev's Implementation)`
- **Requires:** Archipelago 0.6.4+, Gravity Circuit 1.2.2 on Windows, or Linux / Steam Deck through Proton

## Features

- **Stage access:** the stage select is locked per stage until its Access item is found. Optionally, Fortress 1 and 2
  have Access items too, so only Fortress 3 is go mode.
- **Regions:** each stage is split into checkpoint subregions that follow the game's checkpoint menu.
- **Checks:** up to 593 in total.
  - Bosses, rescue bots, boosters and palette chips (92 base).
  - Optional: big and small money caches, data chips, and shopsanity for Nega's and the Nurse's shops.
- **Items:** stage Access, boss Burst Techniques, booster chips (Air Jumper is progression), health and burst
  upgrades, armor paints, varied filler, and optional traps.
- **Overlay:** in-game connection panel (F9), message feed and check counter.
- **Shopsanity:** shops show what each slot sends and hint progression items.
- **Multiworld:** DeathLink, offline play (checks are sent on reconnect) and Universal Tracker support.
- **PopTracker pack:** real stage maps, autotracking, map following and hint highlighting.

## Repository layout

```
apworld/gravity_circuit/   Archipelago world (options, regions, rules, data)
client/                    In-game client, installed into %APPDATA%\Gravity Circuit\
  main.lua                 Loader that runs before the game's own main.lua
  archipelago/             Protocol client, game hooks, overlay, WinHTTP and LuaSocket websockets
packaging/                 Files shipped in the release zip (installer, player guide, YAML template)
tools/                     Build script and generators for data, caches, data chips and the PopTracker pack
tests/                     Data consistency tests
docs/DEVELOPMENT.md        How the client hooks into the game
```

## Installing (players)

Download the release zip and follow its `README.md`. In short:

1. Add `gravity_circuit.apworld` to Archipelago's `custom_worlds`.
2. Run `Install Mod.bat`.
3. In game, press **F9**, enter the server, slot and password, then start a new game in an empty save slot.

## Building

Requires Python 3.10+.

```bash
python tools/build.py
```

This regenerates `client/archipelago/data.lua` and writes `dist/gravity_circuit.apworld` and
`dist/GravityCircuit-Archipelago-<version>.zip`.

To install the client from the repository for testing:

```bash
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File packaging/install.ps1
```

### Regenerating game data

These generators read your installed copy of the game. Set `GRAVITY_CIRCUIT_EXE` if it isn't in the default Steam
location.

```bash
python tools/gen_money_caches.py
python tools/gen_data_chips.py
```

### PopTracker pack

The stage maps are rendered by the game:

1. Create an empty `%APPDATA%\Gravity Circuit\archipelago\export_maps.flag` file.
2. Start the game once. It exports all maps and closes itself.
3. Build the pack. It needs Pillow.

```bash
python tools/build.py --poptracker
```

The resulting pack contains images derived from the game, so keep it for personal use.

## Testing

```bash
python -m unittest discover tests
```

## Credits

Gravity Circuit is by Domesticated Ant Games. This project contains no game files. Developed by Murat Kaan Tekeli.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 Murat Kaan Tekeli. The license covers this project's code only. Gravity Circuit and its assets

notes.text:
### New
- **Linux / Steam Deck support (Proton).** When WinHTTP's websockets aren't available, the client connects through
  LÖVE's LuaSocket instead (`ws://` only; archipelago.gg and self-hosted servers accept it). Run `sh install.sh`
  to install the mod into the game's Proton prefix.
- **Shopsanity info in the shop itself.** The shop's description box shows what the selected slot sends and to
  whom, with the item name coloured by class (progression, useful, filler, trap).

### Changes
- **New overlay.** Messages use the game's font, coloured like the Archipelago text client, and sit in the bottom
  left so they no longer cover the health bar. The AP status line moved to the top; it hides a few seconds after
  connecting and comes back when disconnected, paused or with F9 open.
- Money cache pickups and applied refills no longer print a message.
- **Clearer connection errors.** The client says what went wrong (unknown host, nothing on that port, timeout,
  not an Archipelago server, wrong slot or password) and what to check. Pasted addresses are cleaned up, and a
  bad address or a refused connection no longer retries forever.
- Fewer hitches: server messages are decoded off the main thread, data packages are cached between connections,
  and the log is written in batches.

### Logic
- **"Data Chip - Nega"** now requires all 8 stage Access items. The chip is inside the HQ healing tube, which only
  opens after all 64 rescues.

### Fixes
- Fixed checkpoint refills not filling the new segment after receiving a Burst Booster.

### PopTracker
- The pack (now 0.7.0) shows hub NPC data chips (Fix, Shock, Yuki, K.I.D, Amadeus, Mighty, Tech) as Inspect until
  the rescue that brings that NPC to HQ is checked, and follows the new Nega logic.
